task_title: Wire Floor 3 starter-Companion pick and enlarge cavern spawn room

plan_review.notes: Concerns: (1) silent no-starter fallback on species-resolution failure — fixed by adding a loud console.warn degradation signal + offer-scan fallback in selectFloor3StarterCompanion; (2) loadout presentation hard-coded to floorId rather than scenario-driven — accepted as out-of-scope architectural refactor for this bug-fix PR, noted for future work; (3) enlarged spawn room needs multi-seed invariant coverage — added a new 5-seed test in cave-system-generator.test.ts asserting spawn room size + reachability.
